svg.aria-label: From a change to a release. make check runs gofmt, go vet, staticcheck, shellcheck, the unit tests and the layers test. make integration runs real zellij releases in throwaway containers. CI runs both on every push and pull request with a release build. A vX.Y.Z tag runs all of CI, then builds the archives, packages, checksums and the installer, and pushes the demo image.
